chk.text: Minamo, the wizard school of Kamigawa, is where the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting as the Kami War begins, with Pipe arguing for non-interference.
Hidetsugu then assaults the school, defeats Keiga, destroys the Academy, and summons the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
He nearly kills Toshi and Kiku until Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and Toshi stabs the other, and O-Kagachi tears the oni in two.
Michiko and her party are at Minamo during the attack, and Toshi saves them.

bok.text: At Minamo, Michiko speaks with Mochi and learns that what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, while Toshi learns of the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks the school.
Toshi freezes Mochi, drops the Taken One at his feet hoping Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it, and teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.

sok.text: Ogres and oni sweep through Minamo while scrollkeepers hold their posts, and Toshi finds the oni eating the library and meets Hidetsugu, who wants his full commitment, which Toshi refuses.
Toshi uses Night's Reach to chase off the Oni of Chaos, and when Hidetsugu chokes Kiku and Toshi, Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu in the eyes.
When O-Kagachi appears, the Oni of Chaos flees, and Minamo is abandoned, leaving its younger students thrust into a war beyond their skill.

neo.text: Minamo becomes a frontline at the outbreak of the Kami War as kami emerge from the Falls, and Choryu kills Kobo, bringing the Hyozan Reckoners' revenge upon the school.
Hidetsugu attacks Minamo, defeats Keiga, destroys the academy and decapitates headmaster Hisoka, and he summons the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos, which feeds on the academics and their knowledge.
Toshi banishes the oni when it tries to claim That Which Was Taken, and O-Kagachi tears it in half, destroying what remained of the academy in the battle.
After the war Minamo is rebuilt, but it later declines and is replaced by Otawara.
